features: Health monitoring - Tracks heart rate, heart rate variability, blood oxygen, blood pressure, stress and mood
Battery performance - 140 mAh rechargeable battery with 8 to 12 days of normal usage and magnetic charging
Sports tracking - Supports 113 sports modes with step counting, calorie tracking, distance measurement and exercise records
Comfortable design - Nylon strap with 18 mm band size and IP68 rated water and dust resistance
Sleep and reminders - Tracks sleep patterns and supports sedentary reminders, alarms, exercise goals and women's health reminders
